 Zion Williamson logs three steals Wednesday 
 by Ari Koslow | Pelicans Correspondent | Thu, Oct 22nd 2026, 2:48am EDT 
 Zion Williamson scored 22 points (7-16 FG, 2-4 3PT, 6-6 FT) to go along with three rebounds, three assists and three steals in the Pelicans 123-120 loss against the Pacers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Williamson hit more shots in the season opener than he did all of last year, which is notable. He'll remain a consistent producer as long as he can stay healthy.
